feedback: I want to add more flare and perspective in the game, like right now its just flat but in the original beamrider game, the enemies were coming in from the horizon, and when they died there was a nice subtle animation to it, can you add all of that?

selection.reason: Adding perspective requires changing how the game renders in 'draw' (mapping 2D to pseudo-3D) and possibly how enemies spawn in 'spawnEnemy'. Adding death animations requires introducing a particle system, which involves adding globals in 'prelude', initializing them in 'resetGame', and updating/drawing them in 'draw'.
